neighbours.label: names of the Microsoft Office XML file formats: the 'XML'/'ML' token in 'Office Open XML', 'OOXML', 'SpreadsheetML', 'WordprocessingML' (not XML in general)
fire: Since 2007, Word documents have been saved in the Office Open XML format by default.
Each sheet of the workbook is described in SpreadsheetML within the zip archive.
Critics argued that OOXML was too long a specification to review properly.
Paragraph styles in the document are expressed in WordprocessingML tags.
LibreOffice can import files written in Office Open XML, though some layout is lost.
The converter turns a table of numbers into SpreadsheetML that Excel can open.
The standards body received many comments on OOXML during the ballot.
Slides in a deck are stored as PresentationML parts alongside the media files.
quiet: Since 2007, Word documents have been saved in a compressed format by default.
Each sheet of the workbook is described in a separate file within the zip archive.
The site map is written in XML and submitted to the search engine.
The web page is written in HTML with a few lines of CSS.
LibreOffice can import files from older word processors, though some layout is lost.
The accountant keeps the budget in an Excel workbook with twelve tabs.
The settings are kept in a YAML file next to the script.
Vector drawings on the page are stored as SVG, a markup for graphics.

notes: Probes: SpreadsheetML 0.91, 'Office Open XML' 0.76, OOXML 0.43, openpyxl 0.39, WordprocessingML 0.39; generic XML 0.02-0.05, '.xlsx file' 0.13, 'Excel workbook' 0.03. 'PresentationML' in the test is untried.
